frostrail-release-date.title: Frostrail Release Date
frostrail-release-date.lede: Frostrail is planned to enter Steam Early Access in Q4 2026. FakeFish and Shiro Unlimited have not announced an exact release day or price.
frostrail-release-date.imageAlt: Official Frostrail key art with survivors and the armored steam train

sections.title: Current release window
paragraphs: The official Steam store lists a Q4 2026 Early Access window. A specific day has not been announced, so dates shown by databases that use December 31 as a placeholder should not be treated as confirmation.

sections.title: Early Access plans
paragraphs: FakeFish expects Early Access to last approximately one year. The starting version is planned around the core gameplay loop, while the full version is expected to add more biomes, locations, dungeons, loot, weapons, train upgrades, and co-op situations.
bullets: More content and systems planned through Early Access
Timing and scope can change during development

sections.title: Price and version 1.0
paragraphs: No price is public. The official Early Access statement says the price may increase when Frostrail reaches version 1.0.

sources.label: Official Frostrail Steam page and Early Access statement

seo.title: Frostrail Release Date: Early Access Window & Price
seo.description: Frostrail is planned for Steam Early Access in Q4 2026. See the verified release window, platform, Early Access duration, price status, and TBA exact date.

frostrail-system-requirements.title: Frostrail System Requirements
frostrail-system-requirements.lede: Frostrail requires a 64-bit Windows PC, but FakeFish has not yet published minimum or recommended CPU, GPU, memory, storage, or sound specifications.
frostrail-system-requirements.imageAlt: Official Frostrail gameplay screenshot from inside the train cab

sections.title: Minimum requirements
paragraphs: The Steam store currently lists a 64-bit processor and operating system as required. Every component line beyond that is marked TBA.

sections.title: Recommended requirements
paragraphs: The recommended specification is also unpublished. Do not use estimates from unrelated Unreal Engine 5 games as Frostrail requirements.

sections.title: Engine & performance status
paragraphs: The official FAQ identifies Unreal Engine 5. Following the November 2025 playtest, the team described performance, AI, usability, accessibility, and tutorials as areas still being improved.
bullets: PC and Steam are the launch priority
Final optimization targets and graphics options: TBA

sources.label: Official Frostrail FAQ and development posts

seo.title: Frostrail System Requirements: Minimum & Recommended PC Specs
seo.description: Official Frostrail system requirements status: 64-bit Windows required, Unreal Engine 5, and minimum or recommended CPU, GPU, RAM, and storage currently TBA.

frostrail-multiplayer.title: Frostrail Multiplayer & Co-op
frostrail-multiplayer.lede: Frostrail supports single-player and online co-op for crews of one to four. Players share responsibility for expeditions and the Eden Engine rather than selecting announced fixed classes.
frostrail-multiplayer.imageAlt: Two Frostrail players defending a train carriage in online co-op

sections.title: Player count & modes
paragraphs: Steam lists both single-player and online co-op, while the official FAQ states that crews contain one to four players. The game is designed so the train and expedition loop can be played solo or shared.

sections.title: Co-op gameplay
paragraphs: Crews operate, maintain, expand, and defend the Eden Engine, then explore frozen levels for materials, equipment, and Relics. Public information does not announce class locks, so crew roles should be treated as situational responsibilities.
bullets: Coordinate fuel, power, driving, repair, and train defense
Share scarce ammunition and crafting resources

sections.title: Unconfirmed network features
paragraphs: Cross-play, cross-progression, local co-op, split-screen, matchmaking details, server hosting, latency options, save ownership, drop-in/drop-out behavior, and voice chat have not been officially specified.

seo.title: Frostrail Multiplayer: Co-op Player Count & Online Features
seo.description: Frostrail supports 1–4 players in single-player and online co-op. See the verified crew loop and current status of cross-play, matchmaking, local co-op, and servers.

frostrail-console.title: Is Frostrail Coming to Console?
frostrail-console.lede: No PlayStation, Xbox, or Nintendo version is confirmed. FakeFish is prioritizing Windows PC and Steam, with console ports to be evaluated for version 1.0 and beyond.

sections.title: Official console status
paragraphs: The April 2025 FAQ says PC and Steam are the current focus. The team plans to evaluate console ports for version 1.0 and beyond, which is not the same as announcing a console release.

sections.title: Controller support
paragraphs: Controller support is planned, but the FAQ warned it may not be available at the initial Early Access launch. Controller support on PC does not confirm a console port.

sections.title: Linux & macOS
paragraphs: Linux support has been described as tentative. Neither Linux nor macOS is confirmed; Windows PC remains the priority.

seo.title: Is Frostrail Coming to PS5, Xbox or Console?
seo.description: Frostrail is PC and Steam first. Console ports are only being evaluated for version 1.0 and beyond; PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo, Linux, and macOS are not confirmed.

about-frostrail.title: About Frostrail
about-frostrail.lede: Frostrail is a dieselpunk open-world survival-crafting FPS for one to four players, developed by FakeFish and published by Shiro Unlimited in Unreal Engine 5.
about-frostrail.imageAlt: Official Frostrail key art showing the train and Penitent Gardeners

sections.title: What kind of game is Frostrail?
paragraphs: Frostrail combines first-person combat, open-world survival crafting, exploration, base building, horror, inventory management, and resource management. Its defining base is an armored train called the Eden Engine.
bullets: Cold, heat, food, clothing, Relics, and dungeons

sections.title: Setting & story premise
paragraphs: The former empire was frozen after its Emperor made a pact with the Void. Players are Penitent Gardeners traveling north aboard the Eden Engine, scavenging abandoned settlements, wreckage, ruins, bunkers, strongholds, and dungeons while fighting Revenants and eldritch horrors.
facts: Empire frozen by a Void-linked pact

sections.title: Developer & publisher
paragraphs: FakeFish is the Finnish studio behind Frostrail; many team members previously worked on Barotrauma. Shiro Unlimited is the publisher. The official FAQ identifies Unreal Engine 5 as the game's engine.

sections.title: Languages & Steam features
paragraphs: Steam currently lists interface and subtitles in seven languages and no full-audio localization. The store also lists Steam Achievements and Family Sharing.
facts: English, French, German, Spanish (Spain), Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Simplified Chinese
